facts.fact: The Autorite de protection's register lists decision 2024-0996 of 16 January 2024 giving a warning and formal notice to the METFPA ministry and the company Kaydan Groupe.
The Autorite de protection de la Republique de Cote d'Ivoire lists its own dated decisions from 2016 to January 2024.
Authority decisions of 2017 and 2021 are made in application of loi n 2013-450 of 19 June 2013 on personal data protection.
The authority's register lists normative decisions, including 2021-0676 of 4 August 2021 setting the control procedure and 2023-0920 of 20 July 2023 approving the 2023 controls list.
